# Grabbit MCP

Nobody can read all of Reddit. **Grabbit can.**

[Official Grabbit MCP documentation and setup guide](https://www.grabbit.sh/mcp-server)

Remote Streamable HTTP endpoint:

```text
https://mcp.grabbit.sh/mcp
```

Grabbit MCP helps AI agents find Reddit buyer-intent threads, check subreddit rules, read conversations, and manage lead workflows from any MCP client.

Grabbit does not automatically post replies to Reddit. Users publish from their own Reddit accounts.
